First release: a simulated 5 kW solar inverter and the suite that tests it.

- **System under test:** own simulator with a physical model (sun, clouds, clipping, soft start, anti-islanding,
  over-temperature), SunSpec models 1, 101, 120 and 123, Modbus RTU and Modbus TCP servers.
- **Tests:** 359 on three links (in memory, virtual serial ports, TCP), 18 browser tests of the visual page,
  3 bench tests for a real RS-485 line.
- **Three independent clients:** hand-built frames, pymodbus, the official SunSpec client (pysunspec2).
- **Test quality:** 38/38 planted bugs caught.
- **Visual page:** the project in two minutes, a live inverter with planted bugs, the bytes on the wire, the last
  run replayed, the bug hunt. English and Russian.
